summary_1line: Garuda spares a Brahmana he swallowed, meets his father Kasyapa, and learns of a cursed elephant and tortoise he can eat.

image_candidates.scene_text: Inside Garuda’s blazing throat, a Brahmana and his Nishada wife emerge alive as the giant bird opens his beak to release them.
Garuda, wings spanning the sky, speaks with the sage Kasyapa while hovering above a sacred lake.
A colossal elephant drags a massive tortoise from a sacred lake as the waters churn and the beasts prepare to fight.
